2486f4ae0ef03905.description: Lead development accounting and commercial finance activities for development programs and projects, ensuring accurate financial reporting, cost governance, budget control, and financial performance management throughout the project lifecycle. Provide financial and commercial oversight of development expenditures, commitments, forecasts, and investment performance to support informed decision-making and effective capital management. Drive financial governance, compliance, and process excellence while supporting strategic development and commercial objectives. Section III: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACCOUNTABILITIES Key Responsibilities • Lead development accounting activities across assigned development projects, portfolios, and capital investment programs. • Oversee project cost accounting, capitalization processes, expenditure tracking, accruals, reconciliations, and financial reporting activities. • Manage development budgets, forecasts, commitments, cash flow projections, and financial performance monitoring. • Review and validate project-related financial transactions, contractor payments, consultant invoices, and capital expenditure allocations. • Ensure compliance with accounting standards, capitalization policies, financial governance requirements, and internal controls. • Collaborate with Development, Commercial, Project Delivery, Procurement, Treasury, and Finance teams to ensure financial alignment and reporting accuracy. • Support business case development, investment evaluations, development feasibility assessments, and financial decision-making processes. • Monitor project financial risks, funding requirements, cost variances, and forecast changes, recommending corrective actions where necessary. • Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end development accounting activities and reporting requirements. • Prepare financial reports, executive dashboards, management presentations, and governance submissions related to development performance. • Coordinate audit activities and ensure the availability of accurate financial records, supporting documentation, and accounting evidence. • Lead and develop development accounting teams while promoting continuous improvement, automation, and financial best practices. Section IV: KEY INTERACTIONS Key Internal Interactions • Development Teams • Commercial Teams • Project Delivery Teams • Finance and Accounting Teams • Treasury Team • Procurement Department • Internal Audit • Executive Leadership Key External Interactions • External Auditors • Consultants • Contractors • Financial Advisors • Regulatory Authorities • Service Providers Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. • Master's degree preferred. Professional Certifications • CPA, ACCA, CA, CMA, SOCPA, CFA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred. Skills • Development accounting • Project and capital accounting • Financial reporting • Budgeting and forecasting • Cost management and analysis • Capital expenditure governance • Financial controls and compliance • ERP and financial systems • Stakeholder management • Leadership and team development Experience Years of Experience • 10–15 years of progressive experience in accounting, development accounting, commercial finance, project finance, financial reporting, or related disciplines. Nature of Experience • Managing accounting and financial reporting activities for major development, infrastructure, construction, or capital investment projects. • Overseeing project cost accounting, capitalization, budgeting, and forecasting processes. • Supporting development feasibility, investment evaluation, and financial performance management. • Managing financial governance, audits, and compliance requirements within complex project environments. • Leading finance or accounting teams and supporting executive-level decision-making through financial analysis and reporting.

240acbc92cf03a23.description: About My Clinic KSA My Clinic KSA is a leading multispecialty outpatient care provider in Saudi Arabia, established in 2017. The organization is committed to innovation and core values of care, collaboration, ambition, and responsibility, aiming to help individuals live healthier lives. Role Summary My Clinic KSA is seeking a Senior Database and System Administrator for a full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for providing comprehensive database and system administration support to ensure the availability, performance, integrity, and security of the organization’s databases and server infrastructure. A primary focus will be on databases supporting the Hospital Information System (HIS), as well as other clinical, business, and corporate applications. The administrator will work closely with application, infrastructure, and business teams to maintain stable, secure, and high-performing systems that support uninterrupted hospital operations. Key Responsibilities Administer, install, configure, upgrade, and patch database platforms, primarily Microsoft SQL Server, for HIS and other applications. Monitor database performance, capacity, and availability, proactively tuning queries, indexes, and configurations. Design, implement, and regularly test backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures to meet RPO/RTO objectives. Implement and maintain high availability and replication solutions such as Always On Availability Groups, clustering, and log shipping. Manage database security, including user access, roles, privileges, encryption, and auditing, in compliance with organizational policies and healthcare data privacy requirements. Perform routine database maintenance activities, including integrity checks, index maintenance, statistics updates, and housekeeping jobs. Support HIS upgrades, application releases, data migrations, and integrations by preparing environments and executing database scripts. Coordinate with application teams and vendors to review database changes, troubleshoot data-related issues, and conduct root cause analysis. Administer Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms (*, VMware, Hyper-V), and related storage, including provisioning, patching, and capacity planning. Manage Active Directory, group policies, user accounts, and core infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, file and print) in coordination with the infrastructure team. Monitor server health, system logs, and security alerts, applying operating system and security patches according to change management procedures. Maintain accurate technical documentation, including database and server inventories, configurations, standard operating procedures, and recovery runbooks. Participate in on-call rotations and after-hours maintenance windows to ensure continuity of critical hospital systems. Contribute to IT audits, compliance reviews, and continuous improvement of database and system administration practices. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in database and system administration. Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration. Experience with Windows and Linux server administration and virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V). Strong understanding of data security, backup, recovery, and high availability solutions. Work Location This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

Key Responsibilities Drive in-store CX initiatives. Plan succession for team members based on readiness. Promote the loyalty program (MUSE) and ensure the floor team's knowledge about app offerings. Ensure the store team is working towards common goals. Promote omnichannel sales. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 6 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Career Development and Benefits Chalhoub Group supports career progression through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities, and exposure to various assignments within the role or through internal mobility. The company provides a competitive benefits package, which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies, and exclusive employee discounts. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Chalhoub Group is committed to inclusion and diversity, recognizing the value of diverse thought, culture, background, abilities, and perspectives. 249a9618060ba0c4.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking a QA/QC Manager to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves leading and overseeing the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Project Quality Management System (PQMS) and project governance framework across all CAPEX projects. The QA/QC Manager ensures alignment with ISO 9001, Hill International protocols, and governance requirements, driving stage-gate compliance and P3M3 maturity improvement. Key Responsibilities Act as the PMC representative for all QA/QC matters, coordinating between the contractor, client, and supervision team during project execution. Develop, manage, and continuously update project-specific Quality Management Strategies and Project Quality Plans (PQP) across all CAPEX projects. Establish, implement, maintain, and continuously improve the P&TA Project Quality Management System (PQMS), ensuring alignment with ISO 9001, Client standards, and Hill International protocols. Lead the implementation and management of Matarat's Project, Program & Portfolio (P3) governance framework across all projects. Develop, implement, and monitor stage-gate governance processes to ensure compliance with Matarat's strategic requirements and project approval controls. Lead P3M3 implementation and improvement initiatives, sustain Level 3 maturity, and establish a roadmap towards Levels 4 and 5. Review and enhance existing PQMS and project governance processes to ensure alignment with Matarat's evolving P3 governance framework. Develop project quality and governance dashboards, analyze project performance data, identify trends, monitor risks, and drive improvement initiatives. Lead the digitization of PQMS and project governance processes through OpenText to streamline workflows, eliminate manual activities, and improve operational efficiency. Review and approve PQPs, ITPs, method statements, material submittals, technical documents, and contractor QA/QC personnel qualifications to ensure compliance. Plan and lead internal and external quality audits, technical compliance audits, site inspections, and surveillance activities to ensure adherence to contractual and project requirements. Manage NCRs, investigate recurring quality issues, monitor root cause analysis, and ensure timely and effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate quality documentation, asset inspections, commissioning requirements, and final handover certifications to ensure successful project completion. Establish quality KPIs, monitor project compliance, and prepare regular quality performance reports and dashboards for project directors and senior management. Lead QA/QC personnel, manage quality inspectors, and deliver PQMS, governance, and quality awareness training to P&TA teams, contractors, and consultants. Participate in project close-out activities to verify quality documentation and compliance with approved plans. Ensure adherence to Hill International’s Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health policies and procedures. Perform other duties as assigned by the Project Director or line manager. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in quality assurance and quality control roles. Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing Project Quality Management Systems (PQMS). Proficiency in ISO 9001 standards and project governance frameworks. Experience with P3M3 implementation and maturity improvement initiatives. Familiarity with OpenText or similar platforms for process digitization is preferred. Skills and Competencies Strong leadership and team management abilities. Excellent coordination and communication skills for stakeholder management. Analytical skills for performance data analysis and trend identification. Problem-solving skills for managing NCRs and root cause analysis. Ability to deliver training and promote continuous improvement. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. The role requires coordination with various teams including contractors, clients, consultants, and supervision teams across CAPEX projects. Application Process Salary for this position will not be disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply directly.

24bda5cb3cea2b49.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرفاد للمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الأحساء، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية قيادة وتشغيل الشاحنة الصغيرة، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد السلامة واللوائح المرورية. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال قيادة المعدات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة وفقاً لمسارات العمل المحددة وخطط التشغيل المعتمدة. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة، مع الحرص على تجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية على الشاحنة ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للخبراء عند ملاحظة أي أعطال أو خلل يتطلب تدخلاً متخصصاً. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في قيادة المعدات أو الشاحنات الصغيرة. حيازة رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع الشاحنة المطلوبة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للشاحنة وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية وقواعد المرور. بيئة العمل والمزايا توفر شركة الرفاد للمقاولات بيئة عمل متميزة ومرنة في المنطقة الشرقية، الأحساء. كما تقدم الشركة تأميناً طبياً للموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة المعمول بها. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتوفر فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل محترف في قطاع المقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

24d7eac281bb1f4c.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز مصدر الإبداع للرعاية النهارية عن أخصائي علاج طبيعي للانضمام إلى فريقه في الدوادمي، الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة الحالات المرضية، ووضع خطط العلاج الطبيعي، ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تدريب المرضى وذويهم على التمارين اللازمة. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة وهي بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية ووضع خطط وبرامج العلاج الطبيعي ومتابعة تنفيذها. تسجيل البيانات العلاجية وتدريب المصاب وذويه على إجراء التمارين والحركات. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة المستخدمة في العلاج الطبيعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الطبيعي وحفظها. تحديد التمارين والحركات التقويمية اللازمة وتحديد معدلات تكرارها بالتنسيق مع الطبيب المعالج. تدليك المرضى لتحسين أداء عضلات الجسم المصاب وتدريبهم على استخدام الأثقال والآلات الرياضية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال العلاج الطبيعي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات في وضع خطط وبرامج علاجية فعالة. القدرة على تدريب المرضى وذويهم على التمارين العلاجية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الطبيعي في مركز مصدر الإبداع للرعاية النهارية في الدوادمي، الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج العلاج ومتابعة تطورات الحالات. عن مركز مصدر الإبداع للرعاية النهارية مركز مصدر الإبداع للرعاية النهارية هو مؤسسة متخصصة في تقديم خدمات الرعاية الصحية والتأهيل، ملتزمة بتحسين جودة حياة الأفراد من خلال برامج علاجية متكاملة وفريق عمل مؤهل. معلومات إضافية الراتب غير معلن لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

243f503f24962dbf.description: About Johnson & Johnson and MedTech At Johnson & Johnson, the focus is on healthcare innovation to address complex diseases, develop smarter and less invasive treatments, and provide personalized solutions. The company leverages expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech to deliver healthcare breakthroughs. Johnson & Johnson is committed to an inclusive work environment that respects diversity and recognizes the merit of each individual, guided by Our Credo. The MedTech sector at Johnson & Johnson is dedicated to developing advanced, less invasive, and personalized treatments through innovation at the intersection of biology and technology. The Orthopaedics teams contribute to the mobility of over 6 million people annually, providing clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Solutions are developed for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery. Role Overview: VELYS Robotic Assisted Solution Lead Johnson & Johnson is seeking a VELYS Robotic Assisted Solution Lead for a full-time position in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is central to achieving Capital Sales objectives by providing clinical, technical, and commercial support for the VELYS Robotic Assisted Solution portfolio. The Lead will contribute to the development and execution of initiatives designed to enhance competitive positioning, accelerate growth, and facilitate the successful adoption of the VELYS platform within customer accounts. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Support the development and implementation of data-driven programs and initiatives aligned with Capital Sales objectives. Utilize market analysis, competitive intelligence, and customer insights to strengthen commercial strategies. Translate analytics into actionable growth, sales, and customer-retention initiatives. Collaborate with the Robotic Sales Manager and Joint Reconstruction Sales Force to drive customer engagement and accelerate the opportunity pipeline. Serve as a clinical and technical expert for the VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution, demonstrating proficiency in procedural workflows, system operation, and clinical attributes. Provide case support at customer accounts and advise surgeons on procedural techniques and effective use of the VELYS platform. Support the onboarding of new robotic customers and the integration of the system into their clinical practice. Coordinate and execute system installations, site-readiness activities, and customer in-service training. Support post-installation transition, adoption, and continued utilization of the system. Build relationships with clinical and non-clinical stakeholders to support customer satisfaction and long-term partnership. Facilitate Commercial and Professional Education activities for customers and internal teams. Coach junior colleagues by sharing clinical knowledge, best practices, and operational processes. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Education, and Technical Support teams to ensure alignment and delivery of commercial objectives. Support the integration of Joint Reconstruction customers into the broader digital surgery ecosystem. Important Notice Regarding Business Separation Johnson & Johnson has announced plans to separate its Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, which will operate as DePuy Synthes. This planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, regulatory approvals, and other customary conditions. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following the conclusion of the transaction, you would become an employee of DePuy Synthes. Your employment would then be governed by DePuy Synthes' employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be provided by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time, subject to necessary consultation processes.

2492aa7186ca4f2a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية، وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة لضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وبتكلفة تقديرية. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارته المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية الإغلاق، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات متابعة عمليات تطوير الخطط ومراقبة سير العمل. نوع العمل وموقعه هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى مدير إدارة المشاريع مسؤولية ضمان إنجاز المشاريع والبرامج بكفاءة وفعالية، مع الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. يشمل ذلك متابعة كافة جوانب المشروع من التخطيط والتنفيذ إلى الإغلاق والتقييم، مع التركيز على إدارة المخاطر وتحقيق الأهداف المرجوة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في إدارة المشاريع.

244994f09716b4e8.description: About Unifonic and the Role Unifonic, recognized as a Great Place to Work®, operates in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) sector, focusing on business communication solutions. The role requires drafting PRDs, user stories, and executive updates with AI as a first-draft partner, verifying all claims and numbers. Building clickable prototypes in Lovable and understanding AI agent construction, along with identifying and flagging AI risks, are also key. Essential character traits include analytical thinking, problem-solving, ownership, accountability, clear communication, collaboration, adaptability, continuous learning, mentorship, resilience, attention to quality and detail, and advocacy for innovation.

والتشخيص والعلاج لاضطرابات النطق واللغة والتواصل لدى الأطفال. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويهدف إلى تحسين قدرة الأطفال على التواصل والمشاركة في الأنشطة اليومية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي اضطرابات التخاطب مسؤولية تقديم رعاية شاملة للأطفال الذين يعانون من تحديات في التواصل، بما في ذلك: إجراء تقييمات سريرية شاملة لمهارات النطق واللغة والتواصل باستخدام أدوات معتمدة. تصميم وتنفيذ خطط علاجية فردية قائمة على الأدلة العلمية لتلبية الاحتياجات التواصلية لكل طفل. تقييم وعلاج اضطرابات اللغة الاستقبالية والتعبيرية وتأخر تطور اللغة. التعامل مع اضطرابات أصوات الكلام، بما في ذلك اضطرابات النطق والعمليات الفونولوجية. تقديم تدخلات علاجية لاضطرابات الطلاقة والتأتأة وصعوبات التواصل الاجتماعي. تطوير مهارات التواصل اللفظي وغير اللفظي والوظيفي لدى الأطفال ذوي الاضطرابات النمائية والعصبية. على استراتيجيات دعم تطور اللغة والتواصل في المنزل. التعاون مع فريق التأهيل متعدد التخصصات لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة. متابعة التقدم العلاجي وتعديل الخطط بناءً على الاستجابة للعلاج. توثيق التقييمات والجلسات والخطط العلاجية والتقارير بدقة، مع الالتزام بأخلاقيات المهنة ومعايير الجودة وسلامة المرضى. نطاق العمل يشمل الدور التعامل مع الأطفال الذين يعانون من مجموعة متنوعة من الاضطرابات، مثل تأخر تطور اللغة، واضطرابات أصوات الكلام والنطق، واضطرابات الطلاقة، وصعوبات التواصل الاجتماعي، بالإضافة إلى اضطرابات التواصل المرتبطة بالتأخر النمائي، واضطراب طيف التوحد، والحالات العصبية. يتطلب العمل تطبيق تدخلات علاجية مناسبة لعمر الطفل واحتياجاته. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال اضطرابات التخاطب. القدرة على إجراء تقييمات شاملة وتصميم خطط علاجية فردية. معرفة بوسائل التواصل المعززة والبديلة (AAC). مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الأطفال وأسرهم والفريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية وأخلاقيات المهنة وسرية المعلومات. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي اضطرابات التخاطب ضمن فريق تأهيلي متعدد التخصصات في مركز خطوة و مهارة للتأهيل بالطائف. تتطلب الوظيفة التعاون المستمر مع الزملاء وأولياء الأمور لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج العلاجية للأطفال. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في 24ba253a7ca023a5.description: About Unifonic and the Role Unifonic, recognized as a Great Place to Work®, is an AI-native customer experience platform serving over 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company focuses on conversational AI research and development, pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. This part-time role for an Arabic Linguist is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and involves supporting the Text-to-Speech (TTS) team with linguistic analysis and Arabic dialect expertise. Role Overview The Arabic Linguist will contribute linguistic expertise to production projects, focusing on improving the quality, accuracy, and naturalness of Arabic speech technology. This position requires strong expertise in Saudi Arabic dialects, with a preference for native or near-native proficiency in the Najdi dialect. The role involves close collaboration with the AI and TTS teams, providing guidance and support for various voice-related projects. Key Responsibilities Conduct research on the phonological, morphological, and syntactic structures of Arabic, with a focus on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Saudi/Gulf dialects, particularly Najdi. Provide linguistic guidance for the integration of Arabic structures into Sestek products. Act as a linguistic point of contact for the R&D / AI team, translating linguistic requirements into actionable input for engineers. Analyze and review pronunciation data, including grapheme-to-phoneme mappings, diacritization/tashkeel, and lexicons for Arabic TTS and speech recognition systems. Evaluate TTS output quality in terms of pronunciation accuracy, prosody, dialect authenticity, and naturalness, with a particular focus on Saudi Arabic. Provide linguistic guidance and support for Arabic voice data collection and speech synthesis projects, including identifying and onboarding suitable voice talents. Support the coordination and review of voice recording and editing processes to ensure linguistic accuracy and consistency. Support the onboarding and coordination of external Arabic language consultants, providing guidance on linguistic requirements. Review and provide linguistic feedback on data annotation activities and guidelines, ensuring appropriate quality standards for Arabic and Saudi dialect data. Collaborate closely with the Sestek TTS and AI Research teams, providing ongoing linguistic expertise throughout projects. Required Qualifications and Skills Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Arabic Language and Literature, Translation and Interpreting, or a related field. Native proficiency in Arabic, with a strong command of MSA and Saudi Arabic dialects. Native or near-native proficiency in the Najdi dialect is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Arabic dialects beyond Saudi Arabic is preferred. Strong knowledge of Arabic phonology and morphology, and familiarity with the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). Good command of English, as it will be the working language with the R&D / AI team. Strong communication skills and comfort working with technical, non-linguist colleagues. Familiarity with speech technologies (TTS/ASR), voice data collection, or NLP is a plus. Experience working with Saudi Arabic dialects, particularly the Najdi dialect, is highly preferred. Work Environment This is a part-time position that requires the ability to collaborate remotely with teams based in Türkiye and Saudi Arabia. The role is integral to the Engineering team, which is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Unifonic’s systems and technologies. Application Information Unifonic values creativity, collaboration, and innovation, welcoming diverse ideas. As shareholders, team members contribute to shaping the future of the company. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

24fa415931f14a20.job_title: Senior Construction Manager (Infra & Landscape) Saudi National
24fa415931f14a20.description: About the Role Mace Group is seeking a Senior Construction Manager (Infra & Landscape) - Saudi National to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves working on one of the largest programs in Saudi Arabia, a major mixed-use development that includes sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Role Overview This is a delivery-focused role responsible for managing contractor performance, construction activities, program milestones, quality standards, and safety objectives across a complex portfolio of works. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with project management, commercial, project controls, and technical teams to ensure successful delivery in line with program, budget, and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead the construction delivery of infrastructure and landscape packages from mobilization through to completion and handover. Manage and oversee main contractors, subcontractors, and site supervision teams. Monitor site progress against program milestones and implement mitigation measures as required. Drive construction productivity and ensure delivery objectives are achieved. Ensure works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements. Coordinate construction activities across multiple stakeholders and disciplines. Oversee the delivery of roads, utilities, drainage, external works, public realm, and landscape elements. Review contractor methodologies, recovery plans, and short-term programs. Manage site risks, constraints, and interface issues to minimize disruption to delivery. Support project controls and commercial teams with progress reporting, change management, and contractual matters. Chair construction progress meetings and coordinate site-based workshops. Monitor compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements at all times. Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, defect resolution, and handover activities. Qualifications and Requirements Demonstrable experience overseeing main contractors on complex developments. Strong understanding of construction methodologies, sequencing, temporary works, and site logistics. Experience managing roads, utilities, drainage, public realm, hardscape, and softscape works. Strong knowledge of health and safety regulations and construction best practice. Experience managing program, quality, risk, and delivery performance. Ability to build effective relationships with contractors, consultants, and stakeholders. Experience within a PMC, client-side, Delivery Partner, or program management environment is preferred. Professional accreditation such as MCIOB, PMP, PE, CEng, or equivalent is advantageous. Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and relevant work experience on high-valued projects/programs for a project management consultancy business, as required for immigration and client approval. 24b02c0b8018d652.description: The Senior Director – Commercial Partnerships & Distribution is responsible for developing and managing Qiddiya’s commercial partnerships ecosystem and distribution network. The role drives sustainable revenue through strategic partnerships, travel trade relationships, online and offline distribution channels, and tourism activations. The role leads the development of commercial agreements and distribution capabilities across travel agencies, tour operators, online travel agencies, airlines, hospitality groups, corporate travel buyers, and MICE operators. It also oversees commercial performance, partner management, channel development, and team capability while working closely with Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Technology. Commercial Strategy and Leadership Develop and lead the commercial partnerships and distribution strategy in alignment with Qiddiya’s objectives, national tourism priorities, and Vision 2030. Establish multi-year commercial targets, partnership priorities, and pipeline development plans. Position Qiddiya as a leading destination partner for international and domestic travel trade organizations. Develop innovative commercial models, including revenue-sharing arrangements, guaranteed inventory agreements, joint marketing contributions, and partner incentive programmes. Provide senior leadership with regular updates on commercial performance, market developments, risks, and opportunities. Translate the commercial strategy into clear plans, targets, and responsibilities for the Partnerships and Distribution teams. Partnership Development and Management Identify, negotiate, and secure high-value partnerships with travel agencies, tour operators, online travel agencies, airlines, hospitality groups, and corporate travel partners. Build and manage relationships with key local, regional, and international partners. Develop a structured partner classification and tiering model with clearly defined benefits, access, incentives, and joint investment levels. Oversee partnership agreements, memoranda of understanding, and commercial contracts. Establish a structured partner lifecycle covering identification, evaluation, onboarding, activation, performance monitoring, renewal, and closure. Maintain senior-level relationships with executives and decision-makers at key partner organizations. Ensure partnership agreements deliver measurable commercial, visitor, and brand value. Distribution Network Development Lead the development and optimization of Qiddiya’s business-to-business and business-to-consumer distribution network. Oversee relationships and connectivity with online travel agencies and global distribution systems such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Galileo. Develop channel pricing, inventory management, rate parity, and commission policies across distribution channels. Lead the development of a trade partner portal offering booking tools, live inventory, marketing materials, and commission tracking. Evaluate and introduce suitable booking engines, central reservation systems, channel managers, and distribution technologies. Collaborate with Digital and Technology teams to improve customer journeys and conversion across digital distribution channels. Ensure distribution platforms and processes are scalable and integrated with Qiddiya’s operational systems. Revenue and Commercial Performance Manage the commercial revenue and budget for the Partnerships and Distribution function. Establish commercial dashboards to monitor partnership pipeline value, deal progress, conversion rates, channel performance, and revenue against targets. Implement structured pipeline governance and regular commercial deal reviews. Work with Product and Finance teams to develop pricing and yield-management approaches across peak and off-peak periods. Monitor the commercial performance of individual partners, channels, products, and market segments. Conduct market and competitor benchmarking against comparable destinations. Identify revenue risks, performance gaps, and new commercial opportunities and recommend appropriate actions. Team Leadership and Capability Development Lead and develop a team of Senior Managers, Managers, and Specialists across Partnerships and Distribution. Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans for team members. Build a commercially focused, partner-oriented, and data-driven working culture. Identify capability gaps and address them through recruitment, training, coaching, and knowledge-sharing. Support the team in managing complex negotiations, partner relationships, and commercial challenges. Promote Qiddiya’s values and expected standards across internal operations and external partner engagements. Stakeholder Management Act as the main commercial representative for partnership and distribution matters with relevant government entities, tourism authorities, and Qiddiya stakeholders. Work closely with Marketing to deliver joint campaigns, familiarization trips, trade activities, and partner-led activations. Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Procurement, Operations, Product, Digital, and Technology to ensure commercial agreements are compliant and operationally deliverable. Represent Qiddiya at major domestic and international travel trade exhibitions and industry events. Build effective relationships with the Saudi Tourism Authority, Ministry of Tourism, travel trade organizations, and tourism industry bodies. Ensure internal stakeholders receive clear and timely updates on commercial priorities, commitments, and performance. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Tourism Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Master’s degree or MBA in a relevant discipline is strongly preferred. Professional certifications in tourism, destination management, or commercial management, such as CDME or CTA, are advantageous. Minimum of 12 years of progressive commercial experience within tourism, hospitality, destination management, travel trade, or a related industry. At least five years of experience in a senior leadership position.
